item.title: 13k-Mile 2007 Aston Martin V8 Vantage Coupe 6-Speed
item.description: This 2007 Aston Martin V8 Vantage was acquired new by the seller, and it has 13k miles. It is powered by a 4.3-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transaxle and is finished in Midnight Blue over Sandstorm leather. Equipment includes a limited-slip differential, xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, 19" seven-spoke alloy wheels, power-adjustable seats, navigation, and automatic climate control. item.description: This 1975 Pontiac Firebird Formula is powered by a 400ci V8 linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a Positraction differential. item.title: 6k-Mile 2004 Ferrari 360 Spider
item.description: This 2004 Ferrari 360 Spider remained with the original owner in Texas through late 2024 and now has 6k miles. It is finished in Giallo Modena over Nero leather with yellow piping and stitching and is powered by a 3.6-liter V8 paired with a six-speed F1 sequential transaxle. Equipment includes a Capristo exhaust, 18" two-piece BBS wheels, Scuderia Ferrari fender shields, a Challenge-style rear grille, a black soft top, and power-adjustable Daytona-style seats. item.description: This 1998 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S coupe has remained registered in Florida since new and was optioned with the Motor Sound Package, M030 sport suspension, and power-adjustable front sport seats. Finished in black over black leather upholstery, it shows 34k miles and is powered by a 3.6-liter flat-six that drives all four wheels through a six-speed manual transaxle. item.description: This 1993 Lancia Delta Integrale Evoluzione 1 was imported to the US following history in Japan and was fitted with Martini-style graphics before it was acquired by the seller on BaT in October 2023. item.description: This 1967 Dodge Coronet R/T two-door hardtop is one of 162 examples built for the model year with a 426ci Hemi V8 mated to a TorqueFlite three-speed automatic transmission. The car is finished in Yellow over black vinyl, and equipment includes a limited-slip differential, Magnum 500–style 14" wheels, red-line tires, drum brakes, power steering, front bucket seats, a center console, a tachometer, and a Retro Sound head unit. item.description: This 1951 Jaguar XK120 roadster underwent a repaint and an interior retrim as part of a refurbishment completed in the late 1990s.
